meaning.RETAIN_FOR_EXTERNAL_BENCHMARK: Potential AO2/AO3 multi-step candidate; NOT approved or grade certified

meaning.QUARANTINE_TAUGHT_SCOPE: Spring/Summer or exact subskill not confirmed; hold even if problem may be challenging
